plugin_json.description: A Team Lead plus specialist agents, a whole-repo bug sweep (/repo-review) and opt-in, local-only guardrails. Every hook stays off until you create a posture file and trust the project.

agents.name: architect
agents.reason: Upfront design and phase-boundary consultation; reads and plans, writes no production code.

agents.name: backend-coder
agents.reason: Server-side implementation of one focused, testable change.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.reason: Pre-merge review that returns blockers, suggestions and praise.

agents.name: data-engineer
agents.reason: Domain-neutral data pipeline, modeling and query work.

agents.name: deep-researcher
agents.reason: Multi-source research with citations, using Claude's own search and fetch tools.

agents.name: designer
agents.reason: UX direction, wireframes, flows and accessibility checks.

agents.name: documentarian
agents.reason: Stakeholder-facing writing: memos, runbooks, release notes, READMEs.

agents.name: frontend-coder
agents.reason: UI implementation with a render-then-look verification discipline.

agents.name: fullstack-coder
agents.reason: Changes that genuinely cross the client/server boundary in one unit.

agents.name: partner-success-manager
agents.reason: Domain-neutral partner profiles, success plans and QBR material.

agents.name: project-manager
agents.reason: RAID log, task list and weekly status hygiene.

agents.name: prompt-engineer
agents.reason: Authors and critiques agent, skill and prompt definitions.

agents.name: scout
agents.reason: Fast read-a-lot/return-a-little worker for search, grep and inventory.

agents.name: security-reviewer
agents.reason: Security review of diffs touching auth, secrets, input parsing, shell or network.

agents.name: tester-qa
agents.reason: Test plans, flake hunting and coverage gaps.

agents.name: viz-spec-reviewer
agents.reason: Reviews Vega-Lite, Vega and SVG specs for correctness and safety.

skills.name: agent-quality-rubric

skills.name: audit-ci-gates

skills.name: create-pr

skills.name: cross-platform-determinism
skills.reason: Rules for scripts whose output a repo commits and CI diffs; prose only.

skills.name: declarative-visualization
skills.reason: Vega-Lite, Deneb and SVG authoring with a local spec linter.

skills.name: diff-budget
skills.reason: Per-PR file-count and line-count budget discipline; prose only.

skills.name: draft-agent-brief

skills.name: game-theory-basics
skills.reason: Short reference for strategic-interaction reasoning; prose only.

skills.name: new-worktree
skills.reason: Creates an isolated git worktree under .claude/worktrees/.

skills.name: permission-hygiene
skills.reason: Diagnoses a project's Claude Code permission setup; reads settings, writes nothing.

skills.name: prompt-pattern-library
skills.reason: Catalog of applied prompt patterns; prose only.

skills.name: pseudonymize
skills.reason: Reversibly pseudonymizes names and entities in text before it is shared; local script.

skills.name: quantitative-problem-solving
skills.reason: Structured approach to estimation and quantitative problems; prose only.

skills.name: ravenclaude-core-orchestration
skills.reason: How the Team Lead picks a surface and dispatches specialists; prose only.

skills.name: repo-review
skills.reason: Whole-repo bug sweep across eight dimensions; chunked, cached, subagent-based.

skills.name: run-full-test-suite
skills.reason: Runs the project's full quality gate in order; prose only.

skills.name: spawn-team
skills.reason: Team Lead dispatch playbook: surface first, then specialist, then tier.

skills.name: spec-reread-ritual
skills.reason: Re-read the spec before each task of a multi-task build; prose only.

skills.name: structured-output
skills.reason: Every sub-agent handoff ends with one machine-readable result block; prose only.

skills.name: svg-report-lint
skills.reason: Lints a standalone SVG for geometry, legibility and unsafe content; local script.

skills.name: wall-handling

skills.name: webfetch-hardening

text_edits.replace:
# Edition: posture and state live in the project the person opened (CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR), never in a directory
# found by walking up from the payload's cwd. That cwd is wherever the session last changed directory, which can
# be inside a cloned repository's vendored directory whose own .ravenclaude/ was never trusted, or whose
# runs/ is a symlink out of the project. A host that sets no CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR falls back to the payload cwd.
root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$cwd}"
cwd="$root"
text_edits.reason: The source walks up from the payload's cwd and uses the FIRST .ravenclaude/ it finds, so a posture or a runs/ symlink inside a vendored directory of a cloned repository is honoured even though the posture gate only vetted the project root. The edition resolves the root from CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR only. (The source keeps the walk-up: it exists for per-worktree isolation in the full plugin.)
